ValidationRule.description: If Promo Product not equal to null then Promo Product Line cannot be populated OR if Promo Product Line not equal to null then Promo Product cannot be populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR (
AND ( ISPICKVAL(Type__c,""), ISBLANK(Promo_Product__c), ISPICKVAL(Promo_Product_Line__c,"") ), AND ( ISPICKVAL(Type__c,""), NOT(ISBLANK(Promo_Product__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Promo_Product_Line__c,"")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select either a Product Line or a Product. You cannot add both a Product Line and a Product to a Product Promotion. You also can't leave both the Product Line and Product blank.
